name: Deferred Action Staging via customevents
description: Stages an action list into the engine-owned `customevents` dataset so it runs AFTER a popup interaction completes, rather than immediately. This is how a lookup triggers dependent server calls (fetch account details, fetch currency rate, recalculate a row) that only make sense once the user has actually picked a value.
sourceRefs: examples/fapo-fapi-full-breakdown.md 7.2 (GL code mode:GL, Supplier mode:SL, Currency), 3.6 (grid Stock Master)

actions.description: The deferred action list. MUST end by clearing customevents.

rules: nodeepprocess:true is MANDATORY. Without it the engine resolves the nested expressions immediately (at staging time) instead of storing them raw for later execution.
The staged list MUST end with {"exec":"setdataset","args":{"dset":"customevents","data":null}} — otherwise it re-fires on the next popup interaction.

Inside staged actions, [this.propkey] is NOT available — the row context is gone by the time they run. Park the index in the dslist payload (rowindex:"[this.propkey]") and read it back as [dslist.rowindex]. Nested form: "[DsFrmDetails1.[dslist.rowindex]]" addresses that row.

Prefer mergedataset over setdataset when writing back into a shared payload dataset (e.g. dsVATHeaderDetails) — the real GL chain uses setdataset there and wipes the dataset down to two fields, which only works because Supplier runs afterwards and rebuilds it.

workedExample.description: GL code lookup — fetch account details and derive VAT treatment, deferred until the account is picked.
